title: HtmlKbd
responsibility: Renders the native kbd element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlKbd.attributes
inputs.description: Native kbd attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlKbd.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native kbd element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlKbd
outputs.description: The actual native kbd element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
